cert.blurb: Deimhníonn an deimhniú seo go bhfuil an tástáil IQ Domhanda críochnaithe. Is measúnú é an scór IQ a thaispeántar ar fheidhmíocht chonnaithe bunaithe ar do fhreagraí ar an tástáil.

share.sub: Lig do dhaoine a fhios conas a rinne tú.
note.text: Maidir le do scór. GlobalIQ is designed for educational and entertainment purposes. It is not a clinical assessment, it is not administered by a licensed psychologist, and it should not be used for employment, academic placement, or medical decisions. Results vary with tiredness, environment, and familiarity with the question format.
